headline: Approved renewal of manufacturing cannabis license for Haute & Heady, 4-0.
summary: The Acting City Manager spoke on behalf of the Director of City Planning about the license. Deputy Mayor Oakleaf asked whether Code Enforcement had any concerns, and the minutes say City Staff had none. The motion to approve the renewal passed 4-0.
decisions: Approved the renewal of the manufacturing cannabis license for Haute & Heady, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve the renewal license made by Deputy Mayor Oakleaf and seconded by Councilor Ogilvie. Motion passed 4-0.
